description: [forged] Offline structural validator for a Vietnamese CCCD (Citizen Identity Card number, 12 digits). Parses the 3-digit province/overseas code, 1-digit century+gender indicator, 2-digit birth year, and 6-digit sequence, deriving full birth year and gender, and flags implausible province codes or birth years. No checksum digit exists in this scheme, so validation is structural only. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))
